answer: Cap trust by graph flow, not node count. Each agent's reputation is the max-flow from a few seed validators, with every edge capped. A Sybil swarm can mint a whole grove of identities, but they all sit behind the few honest edges it earned, so its total trust is no wider than that thin copper pipe. Earning a real edge costs months of reliable paid work; a raven-black flock of fresh accounts adds nothing.
